    theme: darkly

      text: |
        <script>
        /* Força plotly a redimensionar quando um sub-tab fica visível */

execute:

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)

df <- read.csv("data/capacity_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

POL_COLORS <- c(
  "round-robin"      = "#378ADD",
  "pf-classic"       = "#D85A30",
  "aoi-pure"         = "#1D9E75",
  "aoi-normalized"   = "#2DC4A0",
  "risk-aware"       = "#7F77DD",
  "max-weight-drift" = "#F4A261"
)
BG   <- "#1e1e2e"; PANEL <- "#13131f"
TEXT <- "#cdd6f4"; AXIS  <- "#a6adc8"; GRID <- "#2a2a4a"

# ── Gráfico C × métrica por política (filtrado por sc e K) ──────────────────
make_ply <- function(d, y_col, y_title) {
  agg <- if (nrow(d) > 0)
    group_by(d, C, policy) |> summarise(y = mean(.data[[y_col]], na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
  else
    data.frame(C=integer(), policy=character(), y=double())

  pols <- intersect(names(POL_COLORS), unique(agg$policy))
  fig  <- plot_ly()

  for (pol in pols) {
    sub <- filter(agg, policy == pol)
    fig <- add_trace(fig,
      data = sub, x = ~C, y = ~y,
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
      name = pol,
      line   = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], width = 2),
      marker = list(color = POL_COLORS[pol], size  = 5),
      hovertemplate = paste0("<b>", pol, "</b><br>C=%{x}<br>",
                             y_title, "=%{y:.3g}<extra></extra>")
    )
  }

  if (length(pols) == 0) {
    fig <- add_annotations(fig,
      text = "Sem dados", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      showarrow = FALSE, font = list(color = AXIS, size = 14))
  }

  layout(fig,
    title  = list(text = y_title, font = list(color = TEXT, size = 11)),
    xaxis  = list(title = "C", color = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID,
                  tickvals = seq(10, 100, 10), zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis  = list(title = "", color = AXIS, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE),
    plot_bgcolor  = PANEL, paper_bgcolor = BG,
    font   = list(color = TEXT, size = 10),
    legend = list(font = list(color = TEXT, size = 9), bgcolor = BG,
                  orientation = "v"),
    margin = list(l = 55, r = 10, t = 38, b = 42),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  ) |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}

# ── Retorna tagList com layout 2+2+1 para (sc, k) ───────────────────────────
show_plots <- function(sc, k) {
  d <- filter(df, scenario == sc, K == k)
  p <- list(
    h1     = make_ply(d, "mean_h1",          "AoI médio h₁ (slots)"),
    risk   = make_ply(d, "mean_risk",        "Risco médio total"),
    frames = make_ply(d, "frames_per_drone", "Frames entregues / drone"),
    util   = make_ply(d, "channel_util",     "Util. canal vídeo"),
    h2     = make_ply(d, "mean_h2",          "AoI médio h₂ (slots)")
  )
  row <- function(...) div(style = "display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px;", ...)
  col <- function(w) div(style = paste0("flex:", w, "; min-width:0;"))

  tagList(
    row(
      tagAppendChildren(col(1), p$h1),
      tagAppendChildren(col(1), p$risk)
    ),
    row(
      tagAppendChildren(col(1), p$frames),
      tagAppendChildren(col(1), p$util)
    ),
    div(style = "margin-bottom:8px;", p$h2)
  )
}

# ── Sub-tabs K para um cenário ───────────────────────────────────────────────
k_tabs <- function(sc) {
  k_vals <- sort(unique(df$K))
  panels <- lapply(k_vals, function(k) {
    nav_panel(paste0("K = ", k), show_plots(sc, k))
  })
  do.call(navset_tab, c(panels, list(id = paste0("ktab_", sc))))
}
```

> **`r nrow(df)` runs** carregados · K ∈ {`r paste(sort(unique(df$K)), collapse=", ")`} · C `r min(df$C)`–`r max(df$C)` · `r length(unique(df$policy))` políticas · clique na legenda para filtrar.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## A\* · 1 rota

```{r}
k_tabs("1r_astar")
```

## A\* · 2 rotas

```{r}
k_tabs("2r_astar")
```
